outputs.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - Panel A is a 3D tomographic reconstruction/segmentation model of the apical end showing structural features (preconoidal rings, apical polar ring, pellicular actin). No plot, graph, or box/violin plot is present, so error bars are not applicable.

PASS - Panel B is a 3D segmentation model of the basal end of the sporozoite showing cytoplasmic and pellicular actin. This is a structural rendering, not a quantitative plot, so error bars do not apply.
PASS - Panel C is a tomogram slice image with highlighted filaments; it is a micrograph, not a graph with statistical summary data, so error bars are not applicable.
PASS - Panel D is a 3D structural model (lateral section) depicting nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular F-actin. No quantitative data plot is shown, so error bars are not applicable.
PASS - Panel E shows a slice through an averaged tomographic volume (image), not a plot with error bars or box/violin elements, so this check does not apply.

PASS - Panel F is a tomogram slice image showing a filament and connecting densities (N=2 observations noted as replication count, not a statistical plot). No error bars or box plots are present, so the check is not applicable.
